description: Sisko takes command of the former Cardassian station above Bajor just as the discovery of the wormhole transforms an isolated outpost into a gateway to the Gamma Quadrant and a focal point for Bajoran politics.

s01e01-02.description: Benjamin Sisko takes command of a former Cardassian station above Bajor and discovers a stable wormhole inhabited by beings outside linear time.

s01e03.description: Kira's loyalty is tested when a Bajoran resistance veteran arrives seeking support for a violent campaign against Federation influence.

s01e04.description: Odo becomes the prime suspect in a baffling murder as distrust of the station's shape-shifting constable spreads through the community.

s01e05.description: An old Bajoran sabotage device releases a contagious aphasia virus, leaving the station crew racing to find a cure as language collapses.

s01e06.description: O'Brien befriends Tosk, a Gamma Quadrant visitor whose pursuers reveal that he was bred to be hunted for sport.

s01e07.description: Vash and Q arrive from the Gamma Quadrant just as a mysterious force begins draining the station's power and threatening its destruction.

s01e08.description: Jadzia is arrested for a murder allegedly committed by Curzon Dax decades earlier, forcing a hearing on responsibility across Trill lifetimes.

s01e09.description: A dying alien criminal hides his consciousness inside a station resident and prepares to seize a valuable shipment.

s01e10.description: After Quark cheats visiting Wadi gamblers, Sisko, Kira, Dax and Bashir become living pieces inside an alien game.

s01e11.description: Grand Nagus Zek unexpectedly names Quark his successor, placing the bartender at the center of a ruthless Ferengi power struggle.

s01e12.description: A Gamma Quadrant fugitive claims to know the origin of Odo's people and offers information in exchange for freedom.

s01e13.description: Sisko, Kira, Bashir and Kai Opaka crash on a world where two armies are condemned to fight and resurrect forever.

s01e14.description: O'Brien is unexpectedly made spiritual leader of a Bajoran village while Jake and Nog try to resolve a dispute between neighboring communities.

s01e15.description: Kira must evacuate a stubborn farmer from land needed for Bajor's recovery while Jake and Nog discover the strange logic of trade.

s01e16.description: The crew's fantasies begin taking physical form across DS9 as an expanding spatial anomaly threatens the Bajoran system.

s01e17.description: Lwaxana Troi becomes fascinated by Odo while an alien computer program attaches itself to the station's systems.

s01e18.description: An alien telepathic archive infects the command staff, forcing them to reenact a deadly political struggle from another civilization.

s01e19.description: Kira investigates a Cardassian patient who may be a notorious labor-camp commander and is forced to confront the meaning of guilt after occupation.

s01e20.description: Religious objections to Keiko's school curriculum ignite a political struggle over faith, science and Bajor's relationship with the Federation.
